title: RealPnl
tagline: An app that enables crypto influencers to prove their actual pnl
description: We have created the project in order for the influencers to be more transparent with the community, as for the most part the problem with their "profitable" trades is the fact that the image is simply from a third party, such as Bybit, so the only way to verify it is by checking that trade via ByBit, however RealPnl allows users to click on link, that would bring them to the specific trade. The influencer can also connect their socials to increase the trust score of that profile actually being them.
how_its_made: We use Supabase for the database, that has all the data, that was input on our page, we generated the design and built it from scratch. We also use different data and infrastructure APIs, such as CoinGecko, Pinata and CoinAPI. We also possibility for users to add their ByBit trades to their profile, so they can verify they were made by them.
